answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 30239 Country: India Title: I Shaikh Altaf Ahmed s/o Shaikh Ashfaque ahmed, on 30-01-2011, at 2.45pm my Baby (Girl) born, my wife name is Heena Tabbaum, please suggest name of my Baby (Girl) As earliest as possible. Question: Assalam o alaikum, i Shaikh Altaf Ahmed s/o Shaikh Ashfaque ahmed, on 30-01-2011, at 2.45pm my Baby (Girl) born, my wife name is Heena Tabbaum, please suggest name of my Baby (Girl) As earliest as possible..... Jazakallah hu khair Answer ID: 30239 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/309/D=1432) Keeping the name Hina Tabassum is also correct. However, it is far better if you choose any name from amongst the names of the holy wives or Sahabiyat i.e. Fatima al-Zahra, Maimuna, Umaima, Juwairiya, Ayesha Siddiqa, Umm Habiba, Safiya etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
